scope: Supplemental historical orthography check only for existing canonical Anatherum tenuispatheum; neighboring accepted A. eremicum synonym boundary

decisions.subject: Accepted name and historical synonym destination
decisions.decision: Anatherum tenuispatheum and Anatherum eremicum remain separately accepted. Andropogon glomeratus var. scabriglumus C.S.Campb. maps to Anatherum eremicum, not A. tenuispatheum.

decisions.subject: Additional spelling evidence from 1986 paper abstract and ITIS
decisions.decision: The abstract of Campbell (1986) as indexed in TreeBASE spells the described new variety 'scabriglumus'. Kew and ITIS also use 'scabriglumus' as the headword; ITIS lists 'scabriglumis' as a synonym/variant spelling. This strengthens the preferred indexed spelling but is not direct examination of page 291 of the 1986 protologue.

decisions.subject: Exact spelling as printed in 1986 nomenclatural protologue
decisions.decision: Preserve prior AT-16 UNRESOLVED until Campbell 1986 Systematic Botany 11:291 original protologue is examined directly. Wipff & Shaw (2018) repeatedly use 'scabriglumis'; TreeBASE-indexed 1986 abstract, Kew, and ITIS prefer 'scabriglumus'. Do not silently normalize all historic strings or assert a nomenclatural correction.
